DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入力した内容をご確認ください。この金額でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check the entered details. Is this amount correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、金額を決め直したいです。今の内容では進めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 確認画面の金額で進めないよう止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me, I would like to reconsider the amount. Please do not proceed with the current details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Stop the process so it does not proceed with the amount on the confirmation screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ最終確認前です。新しい金額は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have not completed final confirmation yet. Have you decided on a new amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ迷っています。相手へ確認してから決めたいので、いったん止めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未決定で相手確認が必要だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am still unsure. I want to check with the other person before deciding, so I would like to stop for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not decided and need to check with the other person. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。未確定の状態で保留にするか、今回の入力を取り消すか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. We will confirm whether to leave it pending without finalizing or cancel this entry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入力を取り消してください。今日のうちに決まっても、同じ確認画面を使わず改めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保留でなく今回入力の取消を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please cancel the entry. Even if I decide today, I will ask again rather than use this same confirmation screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request cancellation of this entry rather than putting it on hold. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取消しを行います。申込書の古い金額も、そのまま次の申込みへ使わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will cancel it. Please do not reuse the old amount on the application form for the next application as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。この紙は取消済みとして分けたいです。後で間違って提出しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧申込紙を次回と分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I would like to separate this paper as canceled so I do not submit it by mistake later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to keep the old application paper separate from the next one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取扱いを確認してお返しします。今回の振込は行われていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check how it should be handled and return it. This transfer has not been made.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認しました。相手と金額を決め、新しい内容で申し込み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未送金を確認し新内容で再申込すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed that. I will agree on the amount with the other person and apply again with the new details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that no money was sent and say that you will reapply with new details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの入力を取り消しました。本日は送金していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have canceled this entry. No money has been sent today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お味はいかがでしたか。こちらを一箱いかがでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: How did it taste? Would you like a box of this?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: おいしかったです。でも今日は買う予定がありません。試食したら買う必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試食で購入義務があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It was delicious. But I do not plan to buy anything today. Do I have to buy it if I tried a sample?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether tasting a sample creates an obligation to buy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入を決めるための試食ですので、無理にお求めいただく必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sample is to help you decide whether to buy, so you do not have to purchase it if you do not want to.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。おいしいと返事したので、買うと受け取られたか心配でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 味への感想と購入意思の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. Since I said it tasted good, I was worried that might have been taken as saying I would buy it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between your impression of the taste and your intent to buy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご感想と購入の意思は別で大丈夫です。商品説明だけお聞きになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your opinion and your intention to purchase can be separate. Would you like to hear just the product explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 保存方法だけ知りたいです。次の買い物で必要なら考えますが、取り置きは頼みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保存方法だけ聞き取置きを求めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I only want to know how to store it. I will consider it next time I shop if I need it, but I am not asking you to reserve any.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you only want storage information and are not asking for a reservation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 冷蔵の商品です。表示の保存条件をご確認ください。取り置きはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is a refrigerated product. Please check the storage conditions on the label. We will not reserve any.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は持ち帰る時間も長いので、今回は見送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持帰り条件も踏まえ見送ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. My trip home is also long today, so I will pass this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide not to buy, taking the conditions of taking it home into account too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。試食の容器はこちらへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Please put the sample container here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 容器を返します。説明をありがとうございました。今日は購入しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容器を返し購入しない意思を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will return the container. Thank you for the explanation. I will not buy it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the container and clearly state that you are not buying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。また必要な時にお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please choose it another time when you need it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 間もなくこちらの門を閉めます。ご退出をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will close this gate shortly. Please leave the grounds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 迎えの車をここに呼びました。まだ十分ほどかかるので、門を少し開けておけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 迎えの遅れを示し閉門延長を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I asked the car picking me up to come here. It will take another ten minutes or so. Could you leave the gate slightly open?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the delayed pickup and ask whether closing can be extended. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この門の閉門時刻は変更できません。お迎えまでに外へ出てお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot change this gate's closing time. Please go outside and wait for your pickup.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。でもこの門の外は道が狭いので、車を止める場所も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 門外の狭い道で停車場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. But the road outside this gate is narrow, so I also want to know where the car can stop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about a stopping place on the narrow road outside the gate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 園内へ戻って駐車することはできません。車の停車場所は道路の規制を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The car cannot come back inside the park to park. Please check road restrictions for where it may stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では迎えの人に、別の出口へ変更できるか聞きます。歩いて出られる東側の出口はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 迎え先変更と別出口の通行を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will ask the person picking me up whether we can change to another exit. Is there an east-side exit I can walk out through?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about changing the pickup place and using another exit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 東側へ向かう通路は今通れます。閉門前に出て、車が安全に停車できる所で合流してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The path toward the east side is open now. Please leave before closing and meet where the car can stop safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。運転する人に道の条件を確認してもらい、歩いて東側へ移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 運転者の安全確認と自分の移動を分担する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will have the driver check the road conditions while I walk to the east side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Assign the driver's safety check and your own movement separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 忘れ物がないか確かめてからお進みください。閉門後は戻れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check you have not forgotten anything before proceeding. You cannot come back after the gate closes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持ち物を確認しました。迎え先を連絡し、閉門前に外へ出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物と連絡を確認し閉門前に退園する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked my belongings. I will tell the driver the pickup location and go outside before closing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check belongings and communication and leave the park before closing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの通路から東側へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12236-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take this path toward the east side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 忘れ物のお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a lost item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗った列車が車庫へ行くと聞きました。そこへ行けば、自分で座席を探せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車庫で自己探索できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard the train I took is going to the depot. If I go there, can I search the seat myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can search for yourself at the depot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車庫へお客様が入って探すことはできません。まず列車を特定します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Passengers cannot enter the depot to search. First, we will identify the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 九時ごろに着いた列車です。運行番号は分からないので、乗った駅も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着時刻と乗車駅で列車特定を助ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was the train that arrived around nine. I do not know its service number, so I will also tell you where I boarded.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Help identify the train using the arrival time and boarding station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お願いします。どの辺りの座席に、何を忘れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do. What did you leave, and roughly where was the seat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先頭から二両目の窓側に、青い布袋を置きました。中には仕事の本があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車両と席と袋の特徴を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I left a blue cloth bag by a window seat in the second car from the front. It contains books for work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the car, seat, and bag's features. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 情報を担当へ伝えます。今見つかっているとは限りませんので、受取場所も確認後の案内になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass the information to the staff member. It may not have been found yet, so we will give collection instructions only after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では車庫へ向かわず待ちます。袋の中に名前を書いた紙があることも伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車庫へ行かず識別情報を追加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will wait without going to the depot. Please also tell them there is a piece of paper with my name inside the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not go to the depot; add identifying information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。連絡先はこの受付で伺います。見つかる前に現地へ行かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will ask for your contact details at this desk. Please do not go to the site before it is found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。列車と特徴を伝え、確認の連絡を待ってから受取先へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見確認後に案内された受取先へ行くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will give the train details and bag features, wait for confirmation, and then go to the collection point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will go to the collection point you are given after the item is confirmed found. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらでお問い合わせを受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take your inquiry here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 調査票についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自由欄に家族の困り事を書きました。具体的なので、名前と連絡先も入れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 調査票へ家族の個人情報を書いたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote about a family member's difficulties in the free-response section. I made it specific, so I also included their name and contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you wrote a family member's personal information in the questionnaire. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この調査は意見を集める物です。個別相談の受付とは別になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This survey collects opinions. It is separate from registering an individual consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここに書けば家族へ連絡が来ると思っていました。本人にはまだ相談していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個別連絡を期待し本人へ未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought writing it here would mean someone would contact my family member. I have not discussed it with them yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you expected individual contact and have not checked with the person. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人の希望を確認して、個別の相談先へ連絡する方法をご検討ください。調査票の情報も見直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check their wishes and consider contacting an individual consultation service. Let us review the questionnaire information too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族の名前を消し、一般的な困り事の意見だけ残したいです。まだ提出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未提出票を書き直し個人名を除きたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to remove my family member's name and leave only a general comment about the difficulty. I have not submitted it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to rewrite the unsubmitted questionnaire without the personal name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では新しい用紙で書き直せます。元の用紙の扱いはご自身で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then you can rewrite it on a new sheet. Please check for yourself how to handle the original sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。家族に支援の相談をしたいか聞き、希望があれば別の窓口へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の希望を聞き別相談先を使うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I will ask my family member whether they want support advice and go to a separate desk if they do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the person's wishes and use a separate consultation service. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談先の案内もお渡しできます。調査票は相談予約にはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can also give you information about consultation services. The questionnaire does not make a consultation appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。匿名の意見と本人の相談を分け、新しい用紙で提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 意見提出と個別予約の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will keep the anonymous opinion separate from the person's consultation and submit a new sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the difference between submitting an opinion and making an individual appointment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが新しい用紙と相談先の案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the new sheet and information about consultation services.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の順番まで、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please wait here until your turn for the test.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一時間かかるなら、その間に職場へ戻って少し仕事をしてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査待ち中の職場復帰を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: If it will take an hour, may I go back to my workplace and do some work in the meantime?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about returning to work while waiting for a test. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外出できるかは検査や状態によります。担当へ確認する前にお帰りにならないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Whether you may leave depends on the test and your condition. Please do not go back before checking with the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。待ち時間なら自由な休憩だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待機を自由休憩と思った誤解を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I thought waiting time was a break I could use freely.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your misunderstanding that waiting was a free break. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 順番が前後したり、途中で確認が必要になったりすることもあります。職場へ何と伝える予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The order may change, or we may need to check something during the wait. What are you planning to tell your workplace?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一時間後に戻れると言っていました。まだ確定していないので、予定を直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場へ伝えた確定時刻を訂正すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I told them I could return in an hour. That is not confirmed yet, so I will correct the plan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will correct the definite time you gave your workplace. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ外出の希望と仕事の予定を伝えます。戻る時刻をこちらで約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the staff member that you would like to go out and about your work schedule. We cannot promise when you will return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。職場には検査が終わるまで戻れる時刻が分からないと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 復帰時刻が不明と職場へ連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will tell my workplace that I do not know when I can return until the test is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell your workplace your return time is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。まずこちらで待ち、担当の説明を聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. First, please wait here and listen to the staff member's explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡しました。外出せず待ち、担当に検査の流れを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外出せず担当説明を待つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have contacted them. I will wait without going out and ask the staff member about the test process.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will not go out and will wait for the staff member's explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎました。この席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have passed it on to the staff member. Please wait in this seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: このメモは上から起きた順番ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are the events in this note listed from top to bottom in the order they happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ。思い出した順に書きました。一番上の出来事が最初ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: メモは発生順でないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. I wrote them in the order I remembered them. The event at the top was not the first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Make clear that the note is not in chronological order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発生した順が分かる所から確認しましょう。確かな前後関係はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us start with the parts where you know the sequence. Are there any events whose order you are certain of?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話が来た後に外へ出ました。でも、その間にメールを見たかは覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 確かな前後関係と不明部分を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I went outside after the phone call. But I do not remember whether I looked at the email in between.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the certain sequence and the uncertain part. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 電話と外出の順は確認でき、メールの位置は未確認ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the order of the call and going out is confirmed, but the email's place is not.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。メールを二番目へ移すと確かな順に見えるので、別の欄に残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不明なメールを確定順へ入れないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. If we move the email to second, it will look like a definite sequence, so I would like to keep it in a separate field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask not to include the uncertain email in the confirmed sequence. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その形で整理できます。時刻が分かる物は、何を根拠にしていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can organize it that way. For events where you know the time, what is the basis?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話は履歴です。外出は記憶だけなので、同じ精度の時刻として書かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 履歴と記憶の時刻精度を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The phone call is based on the call history. Going out is based only on memory, so please do not write them as equally precise times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the time precision of a record from memory. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 根拠を分けて記録します。後で思い出したら、追加として知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record the sources separately. If you remember later, please tell us as an addition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。確かな順番と、位置が分からない出来事を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定順と未定位の出来事を分けて話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will explain the confirmed sequence separately from events whose place in it I do not know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the definite sequence separately from events not yet placed in it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では電話の履歴から順に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us start by checking the call history.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 郵便が届かないとのお問い合わせですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about mail that has not arrived, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ書類をもう一度送るので、最初の分は取り消したことにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再送で最初の郵便を取消したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I will send the same documents again, so please treat the first mailing as canceled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to cancel the first mailing because you will resend it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 未着の問い合わせだけで、最初の郵便が取り消されたことにはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: An inquiry about non-delivery alone does not mean the first mailing has been canceled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。二通とも届くかもしれないので、相手に重複の可能性を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二通到着の可能性を受取人へ知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. Both letters might arrive, so I will tell the recipient about the possibility of duplication.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will inform the recipient that both letters may arrive. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 差出方法によって調べられる内容も違います。最初の控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: What we can investigate also depends on how it was sent. Do you have a receipt for the first mailing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 控えはありません。封筒の写真だけです。受取人がまだ確認していない可能性もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 控えがなく受取未確認の可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not have a receipt, only a photo of the envelope. The recipient may also not have checked yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have no receipt and the recipient may not have checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では受取人の確認もお願いします。再送する場合は、二通の内容を区別できるよう相手と相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please ask the recipient to check too. If you resend it, discuss how they can distinguish the two sets of contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。重要な書類なので、届いた方を勝手に二件分として扱わないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同書類を二件扱いしないよう相手と調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. They are important documents, so I will tell them not to treat the arriving copies as two separate cases on their own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Coordinate with the recipient so identical documents are not treated as two cases. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらではまず最初の差出しについて伺います。再送の受付は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here, we will first ask about the original mailing. Acceptance of a new mailing will be checked separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。最初の分を調べ、相手の確認後に再送を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未着調査と再送判断を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will investigate the original mailing and decide whether to resend after the recipient checks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the non-delivery inquiry from deciding whether to resend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では最初に差し出した日と宛先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please tell me the date and destination of the first mailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お引き出しの口座はご本人の物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the account for the withdrawal your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母の口座です。電話で頼まれたので、母のカードを持って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母の口座とカードで来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is my mother's account. She asked me by phone, so I brought her card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you came with your mother's account and card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お母様のカードをご自身のカードとして使わないでください。代理のご相談として確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not use your mother's card as your own. We will check this as an inquiry about acting on her behalf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話で母を呼べば、その声だけで手続きできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話の声だけで代理手続できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: If I call my mother, can we complete the procedure based only on her voice?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether a representative procedure can be completed using only a phone voice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 電話だけで進められるとは限りません。ご本人確認や代理の条件を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot necessarily proceed by phone alone. The staff member will check identity verification and representative requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では今は出金せず、必要な書類や本人が来られない場合の相談先を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出金前に代理要件の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will not withdraw money now. I would like to know the required documents and where to ask if she cannot come herself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for representative requirements before withdrawing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へつなぎます。お母様が来られない理由を、分かる範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will connect you with the staff member. Please tell us why your mother cannot come, as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 足が痛くて外出しにくいそうです。診断を聞いたわけではないので、本人にも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の外出困難を伝聞として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: She says her legs hurt and it is difficult to go out. I have not heard a diagnosis, so I will also check with her.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the person's difficulty going out as information you heard from them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状況として伺います。カードや番号を使って代わりに操作する前にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will note that situation. Please ask before using the card or number to operate anything on her behalf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は代理の方法の案内を受け、母と準備してから改めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: カード操作せず本人と準備すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Today I will get information about acting on her behalf, prepare with my mother, and consult you again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will not operate the card and will prepare with the account holder. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当を呼びました。出金の処理はまだしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have called the staff member. No withdrawal has been processed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の厚い袋へ入れました。商品の重さだけで買えると思いましたが、袋の重さも入りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参袋の重量が価格に含まれるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put it in my own thick bag. I thought I could buy just the product by weight, but will the bag's weight also be included?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your own bag's weight is included in the price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持参の袋が使えるかと、重さの扱いを確認します。まだ確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check whether your bag can be used and how the weight is handled. Nothing has been finalized yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。袋だけ先に量ればよいと自分で判断し、商品を入れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 容器重量の扱いを自己判断したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I assumed myself that we could weigh just the bag first and already put the product in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you decided how the container weight would be handled on your own. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いったん商品を指定の容器へ移して確認します。ほかの商品が混じっていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will transfer the product to the designated container and check it for now. Are there any other products mixed in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ種類だけです。ただ、袋に名前が書いてあるので、その袋は持ち帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品の種類と自分の袋の返却希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only the same kind. However, my name is on the bag, so I would like to take that bag home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the product type and request the return of your own bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋はお返しします。今日は指定容器で商品の量を確認してからお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will return the bag. Today we will check the product quantity in the designated container before handing it over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。値段を確認し、会計後に自分の袋へ入れ直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 価格確認後に袋へ移したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I would like to check the price and put it back into my own bag after paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to transfer it to your bag after confirming the price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 移し替える場所もご案内します。計量中に追加の商品を入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also show you where to transfer it. Please do not add any more products while we weigh it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。この量で計量し、会計後に案内された場所で袋へ移します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 計量量を固定し会計後に移替えると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Please weigh this amount. After paying, I will transfer it into my bag at the place you show me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm a fixed quantity for weighing and transfer after payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋をお返しします。指定容器で確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your bag back. We will check using the designated container.
